en: Black‑and‑white view of a wide cobblestone street or market square in a European town. On the right stands a large church with a tall clock tower topped by an onion-shaped spire and cross. Surrounding the church are multi‑story townhouses with painted signage; some are inns or restaurants. A decorative column or fountain stands in front of the church. Few pedestrians are visible, dressed in early 20th‑century clothing. The signs on buildings appear to be in German.
